scope: All 122 newly adapted LilyGO model assets, rebuilt from retained local plans and source bytes. The original five models are outside this rebuild and preserved.
byteComparison: Both direct byte equality and SHA-256 are checked for every model.json, build-check.json, stored geometry and retained source copy. Expanded geometry is hashed independently.

execution.synchronizationCorrection: Remove only the exact generated preview-only note/limitation on transition to a source-backed live framebuffer; calibrated physical notes and CAD geometry/provenance remain unchanged.
execution.ordering: Frozen plan priorityRank, newest-first; the expansion report also applies current production catalog chronology corrections.

recipe.scopeNote: This proves byte-identical reconstruction in the observed environment. Direct imports and the explicit OCP VTK dependency are pinned; this is not a complete transitive lock or cross-platform guarantee.

limits: Export/reproduction hashes do not establish physical fit, manufacturing dimensions, component accuracy, assembly placement, hardware compatibility or firmware boot.
The 44 CAD representations were reviewed separately. This pass checks retained source bytes and output, without adding a new visual or physical validation claim.
The 78 photo-derived models retain their partial exterior, scale/depth/placement uncertainty and source-selection limits.
Production declarative loader verification is not a WebGL screenshot, browser interaction, public WASM or physical hardware check.
